title: Out Of Time
description: Denzel Washington is caught in a web of intrigue as he investigates the murder of a woman he was seeing...and all the evidence points to him.

title: Gang Related
description: Tupac Shakur and James Belushi are two corrupt police detectives caught in a dangerous web of deceit in this gritty, smart and tough action thriller.

title: Dark Blue
description: When the LAPD's elite Special Investigations Squad (SIS) is assigned a high-profile quadruple homicide, veteran detective Eldon Perry (Kurt Russell) takes the case. Known for his tough street tactics and a fiery temper, Eldon also tutors rookie Bobby Keough (Scott Speedman) in the grim realities of police intimidation and corruption.  While navigating the tumultuous neighborhoods of South Central L.A., Perry and Keough must track down the cold-blooded killers as well as face their own demons - demons that prove more ruthless than the criminals they pursue.

title: Colors
description: As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a seasoned cop (Robert Duvall) and his new partner (Sean Penn) are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the slums of East Los Angeles.

title: The Last Of The Finest
description: An dedicated cop (Brian Dennehy) who takes a small, undercover squad into a major narcotics ring is 'left out to dry' by his peers.

title: Running Scared
description: Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal.

title: Fatal Beauty
description: A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and tough cop Rita Rizzoli is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

title: Cotton Comes To Harlem
description: Two detectives find themselves on a wild goose chase for stolen cash that takes them from the Apollo Theater through the heart and soul of Harlem!

title: Across 110th Street
description: When Harlem gangsters mess with the Mafia, an unlikely pair of New York's finest must work together to bring justice to the streets!

title: Slaughter
description: An ex-Vietnam, ex-Green Beret captain (Jim Brown) is out to avenge the murder of his parents by the psychotic Dominic Hoffo (Rip Torn).

title: Coffy
description: A one-woman vigilante force is out for revenge against those who hooked her sister on drugs.

title: Foxy Brown
description: Foxy Brown (Pam Grier) vows vengeance against those responsible for the death of an undercover officer.

title: Sheba, Baby
description: Pam Grier plays Sheba Shayne, a private eye who is called back to her hometown to stop the local mob boss from moving in on her father's loan business.

title: Friday Foster
description: A photojournalist Friday Foster (Pam Grier) witnesses the attempted assassination of a prominent African-American figure. Now she is a target!

title: Diggstown
description: James Woods and Louis Gossett, Jr. are a potent one-two punch as a con man and an over-the-hill boxer out to scam Bruce Dern out of a small fortune!

title: Fled
description: Two prison escapees on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk.

title: Hoodlum
description: In New York of the 1920s, three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

title: Malone
description: Ex-CIA agent (Burt Reynolds) has his quiet life disrupted when he stumbles onto a military conspiracy led by a rightwing zealot (Cliff Robertson).

title: The Mechanic
description: In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

title: Mr. Majestyk
description: Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

title: Enter The Ninja
description: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

title: Revenge Of The Ninja
description: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

title: Ninja III: The Domination
description: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

title: Pray For Death
description: A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!

title: Rage Of Honor
description: When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.

title: Bulletproof Monk
description: Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.

title: Ronin
description: Robert De Niro, Jean Reno and Stellan Skarsgard headline a stellar cast in director John Frankenheimer's action-packed and intelligent spy thriller about a group of for-hire mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

title: Brannigan
description: John Wayne stars as Chicago Police Lieutenant Jim Brannigan and  Richard Attenborough co-stars as British policeman Cmdr. Swann in this action-comedy. Brannigan teams up in the U.K. with Cmdr Swann to escort a crime boss back to the U.S.

title: The Package
description: Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

title: Red Corner
description: In this provocative thriller, an American (Richard Gere) on a business trip in China is framed for a brutal murder and soon finds himself at the mercy of a foreign court system he doesn't understand. Can he find the true killer before it's too late?

title: Rob Roy
description: Liam Neeson and Jessica Lange give extraordinary performances as the legendary hero who refused to let his enemies destroy his honor and the loyal woman who gave him the courage to fight! Tim Roth, in an Oscar®-nominated performance, also stars.

title: The Barbarians
description: It is in the time of dragons, witchcraft and sorcery! An evil ruler enslaves a beautiful young queen and she bears him three children. Years later, with the help of a wild young barbarian outlaw woman, her twin sons set out to free their mother.

title: Hercules (1983)
description: Created by Zeus from the energy of a thousand suns, armed with the strength of a hundred men, Hercules triumphs over the forces of darkness in this thrilling adventure that's bigger than the myth itself! Stars Lou Ferrigno and Sybil Danning.

title: The Adventures Of Hercules
description: Lou Ferrigno returns as Hercules, the man with the strength of a hundred! When Zeus' seven mighty thunderbolts are stolen by a group of traitorous goddesses, it's up to Hercules to save the universe from chaos! William Berger also stars.

title: Hercules (2014)
description: Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

title: The Man In The Iron Mask
description: Leonardo DiCaprio leads a phenomenal cast in this thrilling tale of majesty and Musketeers. When the excesses of France's arrogant King Louis XIV begin to threaten his subjects' very lives, the legendary Musketeers reunite to save their country!

title: The Bounty
description: Anthony Hopkins delivers a brilliant portrayal as William Bligh, the sea captain who, in 1787, steered The Bounty on a 27,000-mile voyage into danger, chaos and madness, and whose first mate (Mel Gibson) lead a legendary mutiny against him..

title: Flesh + Blood
description: Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

title: The Battle Of Britain (1969)
description: A stellar cast, including Michael Caine, Laurence Olivier and Christopher Plummer highlights this epic telling of the greatest air battle in history, when the outnumbered Royal Air Force defeated the German Luftwaffe, saving England from invasion.

title: The Bridge At Remagen
description: In this gritty drama, George Segal is a war-weary combat team leader charged with taking a bridge during the Allies’ final push into Germany; Robert Vaughn is his German opposite who’d rather blow up the bridge than have the Americans capture it!

title: A Bridge Too Far
description: With an all-star cast that includes Sean Connery, Anthony Hopkins, Laurence Olivier, Gene Hackman and Robert Redford, this epic WW II drama recreates Operation Market Garden, an ambitious plan to hasten the end of WW II that ended in disaster.

title: Force 10 From Navarone
description: From director Guy Hamilton comes this action-packed WWII adventure! Screen legends Robert Shaw and Harrison Ford star as fearless commandos on a deadly mission to strike a crippling blow against Hitler's army during the darkest days of World War II.
